name: Texas ChalleNGe Academy
what_you_do: Live on the Eagle Lake campus in a free residential program for teens who are disengaged from school. After the on-campus phase there is a follow-up phase with a mentor.
who_can_apply: Youth ages 15 and a half to 18 who are U.S. citizens and Texas residents and are physically and mentally able to take part fully. The program is for youth who are currently disengaged from school.
pay_detail: Free. The page says the program is tuition free to the families it serves.
duration: The page lists a tuition-free 22-week residential program. It also lists a 20-week Residential Phase and a 5 and a half month on-campus phase, then a 12-month Post-Residential Phase. The page says the program requires a 17 and a half month commitment. Confirm with a recruiter.
deadline_text: Classes start in January and July. The application cutoff is normally at least 30 days before class starts.
how_to_apply: Go to an information briefing with a recruiter. Send the application packet and documents. Do a virtual interview with a case manager. Have a mentor fill out a mentor packet. Then a review board decides. Main line: 877-822-0050.
notes: This is for teens who are off track in school, not a job program. Campus: 600 HWY 3013 West, Eagle Lake, TX 77434.
